craft_notes: Sthāyin: utkrānti unit 28. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 2. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Having transgressed time, enjoyment is momentary; what then? Immediate
-departure-giving and another, in which full-oblation then.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kālasyollaṅghya bhogo hi kṣaṇiko@syāstu kiṃ tataḥ sadya+utkrāntidā cānyā yasyāṃ pūrṇāhutiṃ tadā
